scientific_integrity: Proof provides a direct allowed-support graph decomposition and binomial inversion. Finite checks use two separately structured Python scripts. No external scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The original contribution is the complete cardinality enumerator over every even alphabet; the extremal size and maximum-code count are already known from Fimmel et al. (2023), Proposition 5.9; alphabet-four counts are already in Fimmel et al. (2017). No results beyond length three or fixed-point-free complements are claimed. Historical priority of the all-size enumerator is not independently certified.
title: Complete size spectrum of reverse-complement-closed length-three non-overlapping codes
